Name: wal_source_tables
SQL: SELECT * FROM wal_tables() WHERE name IN ('stk_factor','daily_basic','stk_limit','moneyflow','etf_daily','etf_factor','etf_portfolio','margin_detail')

Name: etf_target_duplicate_keys
SQL: SELECT ts_code,ann_date,end_date,symbol,count() AS duplicate_rows FROM etf_portfolio WHERE ts_code IN ('512770.SH','589330.SH') AND ann_date>='2026-01-01' AND ann_date<'2026-10-01' GROUP BY ts_code,ann_date,end_date,symbol HAVING count()>1

Name: etf_latest_report_union
SQL: SELECT ts_code,end_date,count() AS rows,count_distinct(symbol) AS symbols,sum(stk_mkv_ratio) AS weight_sum FROM etf_portfolio WHERE ts_code='512770.SH' AND end_date='2026-06-30' AND ann_date IN ('2026-07-21','2026-08-31') GROUP BY ts_code,end_date

Name: etf_close_alignment
SQL: SELECT count() AS matched_target_rows,sum(case when d.close<>f.close then 1 else 0 end) AS close_difference_count FROM (SELECT ts_code,timestamp,close FROM etf_daily WHERE timestamp>='2026-09-28' AND timestamp<'2026-10-01' AND ts_code IN ('512770.SH','589330.SH')) d JOIN (SELECT ts_code,trade_date,close FROM etf_factor WHERE trade_date>='2026-09-28' AND trade_date<'2026-10-01' AND ts_code IN ('512770.SH','589330.SH')) f ON d.ts_code=f.ts_code AND d.timestamp=f.trade_date
